interview.hardest_part: Building reliable drill–furnace automation and then an automated red-science/production chain through precise inventory and placement interactions while the real-time Death world continues advancing.
interview.likely_failure: Losing too much time to misclicks, resource shuttling, fuel shortages, or unclear screenshot targeting, followed by a biter attack or character death before research automation is established; there is no second attempt.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Hand mining and hand crafting can earn early ore, plate, and gear milestones without research. Burner drills and stone furnaces require no electricity, can be manually fueled and emptied, and keep producing while other actions are performed. Incremental scoring rewards partial progress, and starting equipment plus nearby resources should support basic automation.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Death world biters, pollution-driven aggression, and marathon research costs severely punish delay. Production and enemies advance during thinking, every step permits only one input, and precise pointing, stack handling, furnace fueling, rotations, and entity placement consume many steps. One native death ends the run, making late automation and large science totals especially unlikely.
